about: Every asset in SCION 08 (Sutherland). No image pixels from any source appear in the film; every visible mark is a point, line or arc computed here.

assets.what: bone-length ratios of the dog (neck/torso, head/torso, withers and croup heights/torso), median over 25 keyed frames
assets.source_title: Amateur Film New Jersey C (Home Movies collection)
assets.operation: measured: distances between rig keys (nose, neck, chest, tail, fore/hind feet) in each of 25 keys, median, divided by chest-tail; scaled to a declared torso of 0.62 m (build/world.py rig_ratios). Neck and head lengths then adjusted by hand (x0.95, x0.82) after viewing, because the rig's 'neck' key sits low on the neck.

assets.what: the dog's decision trace: state, x, act per frame; person, door, prompts, timeline
assets.operation: read per frame as requests on the dog's constraint graph and as the pen script's schedule; not drawn

assets.what: dog as a 24-point constraint graph (spine, neck, head, 3-segment tail, 4 legs of 4 points), 53 hard constraints (distances, joint-side limits, floor contacts) plus soft goals and leg-plane constraints
assets.operation: constructed + solved by relaxation each frame; outline attached to the bones

assets.what: person as a 17-point constraint graph, 35 hard constraints, point masses
door leaf: hinge points pinned, equal edges and equal diagonals; dragged by the pen
porch boards, clapboards, window, posts, steps, sill, door frame and casing, horizon, fence, crescent moon, stars
assets.operation: drawn as 3-D line primitives, orthographic projection with 14 degree elevation

assets.what: interior light and the pool on the boards
assets.operation: Sutherland-Hodgman clipping of the opening against the leaf edge, filled with scan-line hatching

assets.what: vector display: spot plotting, display-file-order refresh, P7 flash and persistence, glow
machine room bed, mains hum, relays, display buzz, teletype clicks, pen, voice tones, door creak and drone, paws, settling, tail thumps, breath, Schroeder reverb
tools/paeleo/fonts were not used; QuickDraw, archive frames, masks and found-frames were not used
